entities.summary: Federico Zuccaro, also known as Federico Zuccari and Federigo Zucchero, was an Italian painter, draughtsman, architect and writer. He worked in various cities in Italy, as well as in other countries such as Spain, France, the Spanish Netherlands and England. He was an important representative of late Mannerism in Italian art.
